CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_lead_mission(p_mission_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_missions m
  JOIN public.guild_members gm ON gm.guild_id = m.guild_id
  JOIN public.travelers t ON t.id = gm.traveler_id
  WHERE m.id = p_mission_id AND gm.status = 'active' AND gm.role = 'leader' AND t.user_id = auth.uid()
) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.close_guild_mission(p_mission_id uuid, p_leader_traveler_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.owns_traveler(p_leader_traveler_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Leader not owned' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.guild_missions m SET status = 'closed', closed_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE m.id = p_mission_id AND m.status = 'published'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_members gm WHERE gm.guild_id = m.guild_id
      AND gm.traveler_id = p_leader_traveler_id AND gm.role = 'leader' AND gm.status = 'active');
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mission unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_guild_mission_draft(p_mission_id uuid, p_leader_traveler_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.owns_traveler(p_leader_traveler_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Leader not owned' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.guild_missions m SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = now()
  WHERE m.id = p_mission_id AND m.status = 'draft'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_mission_progress p WHERE p.mission_id = m.id)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_members gm WHERE gm.guild_id = m.guild_id
      AND gm.traveler_id = p_leader_traveler_id AND gm.role = 'leader' AND gm.status = 'active');
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Draft unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ebd_ops.eligible(p_actor uuid, p_lesson uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_lessons l JOIN public.guild_members gm ON gm.guild_id=l.guild_id
 JOIN public.guilds g ON g.id=gm.guild_id JOIN public.travelers t ON t.id=gm.traveler_id JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=t.user_id
 WHERE l.id=p_lesson AND gm.traveler_id=p_actor AND gm.status='active' AND g.status='active'
 AND t.user_id=auth.uid() AND u.is_anonymous IS FALSE AND l.status IN ('published','closed','completed')
 AND (l.audience='all' OR p_actor=ANY(l.target_ids)))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ebd_ops.manager(p_actor uuid, p_lesson uuid, p_permission text DEFAULT 'edit'::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_lessons l JOIN public.guild_members gm ON gm.guild_id=l.guild_id AND gm.traveler_id=p_actor
 JOIN public.guilds g ON g.id=gm.guild_id JOIN public.travelers t ON t.id=gm.traveler_id JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=t.user_id
 LEFT JOIN public.guild_ebd_teachers et ON et.guild_id=l.guild_id AND et.traveler_id=p_actor
 WHERE l.id=p_lesson AND gm.status='active' AND g.status='active' AND t.user_id=auth.uid() AND u.is_anonymous IS FALSE
 AND ((gm.role='leader' AND g.leader_traveler_id=p_actor) OR
 (l.teacher_id=p_actor AND et.active AND CASE p_permission WHEN 'publish' THEN et.can_publish WHEN 'attend' THEN et.can_attend ELSE true END)))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ebd_ops.visible(p_lesson uuid)

AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.travelers t WHERE t.user_id=auth.uid()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION economy_private.collection(p_user uuid, p_traveler uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('card',c.definition,'version',c.version,'receiptId',r.id) ORDER BY c.id),'[]')
 FROM public.inventory i JOIN public.travelers t ON t.id=i.traveler_id
 JOIN public.chest_operations r ON r.id=i.card_receipt_id AND r.traveler_id=t.id AND r.account_id=t.user_id AND r.operation_type='card-starter'
 JOIN economy_private.card_catalog c ON c.id=i.item_id AND c.version=i.card_version
 WHERE t.id=p_traveler AND t.user_id=p_user AND i.quantity=1 AND i.card_revoked_at IS NULL AND c.revoked_at IS NULL
 AND r.rewards->'cardIds' ? i.item_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guild_admin_stats(p_leader_traveler_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(mission_id uuid, participants bigint, completed bigint, pending bigint, completed_recent bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.owns_traveler(p_leader_traveler_id) OR NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_members WHERE traveler_id = p_leader_traveler_id AND role = 'leader' AND status = 'active')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Leader role required' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT m.id, count(p.id), count(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'completed'),
    count(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'pending_approval' AND EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_members participant WHERE participant.guild_id = m.guild_id
        AND participant.traveler_id = p.traveler_id AND participant.status = 'active')),
    count(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'completed' AND p.completed_at >= now() - interval '30 days')
  FROM public.guild_missions m JOIN public.guild_members own ON own.guild_id = m.guild_id
  LEFT JOIN public.guild_mission_progress p ON p.mission_id = m.id
  WHERE own.traveler_id = p_leader_traveler_id AND own.role = 'leader' AND own.status = 'active'
    AND m.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY m.id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guild_chat_private.actor(p_guild_id uuid, p_traveler_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE actor_role text;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Chat access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT gm.role INTO actor_role FROM public.guild_members gm
    JOIN public.travelers t ON t.id=gm.traveler_id JOIN public.guilds g ON g.id=gm.guild_id JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=t.user_id
    WHERE gm.guild_id=p_guild_id AND t.id=p_traveler_id AND t.user_id=auth.uid()
      AND gm.status='active' AND g.status='active' AND NOT coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false)
    FOR SHARE OF gm,t,g;
  IF actor_role IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Chat access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN actor_role;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guild_chat_private.can_access(p_guild_id uuid, p_moderate boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_members gm JOIN public.travelers t ON t.id=gm.traveler_id
    JOIN public.guilds g ON g.id=gm.guild_id JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=t.user_id
    WHERE gm.guild_id=p_guild_id AND gm.status='active' AND g.status='active'
      AND u.id=auth.uid() AND NOT coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false)
      AND (NOT p_moderate OR gm.role IN ('leader','co_leader','moderator'))
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guild_chat_private.mark_read(p_guild_id uuid, p_traveler_id uuid, p_sequence bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM guild_chat_private.actor(p_guild_id,p_traveler_id);
  IF p_sequence IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_chat_messages WHERE guild_id=p_guild_id AND sequence=p_sequence) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid read cursor' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.guild_chat_reads(guild_id,user_id,last_read_sequence) VALUES(p_guild_id,auth.uid(),p_sequence)
    ON CONFLICT(guild_id,user_id) DO UPDATE SET last_read_sequence=greatest(public.guild_chat_reads.last_read_sequence,excluded.last_read_sequence);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guild_invite_private.leader_guild(p_leader uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE guild_key uuid;
BEGIN
  PERFORM guild_invite_private.require_account();
  SELECT g.id INTO guild_key FROM public.guilds g
    JOIN public.guild_members gm ON gm.guild_id = g.id
    JOIN public.travelers t ON t.id = gm.traveler_id
    WHERE t.id = p_leader AND t.user_id = auth.uid()
      AND gm.role = 'leader' AND gm.status = 'active' AND g.status = 'active'
    FOR UPDATE OF g;
  IF guild_key IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Leader required' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  RETURN guild_key;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guild_invite_private.list_invites(p_leader uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE guild_key uuid;
BEGIN
  guild_key := guild_invite_private.leader_guild(p_leader);
  RETURN coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)) FROM (
    SELECT id, created_at, expires_at, revoked_at FROM guild_invite_private.link_invites
    WHERE guild_id = guild_key ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
  ) v), '[]'::jsonb);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guild_invite_private.require_account()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid() AND NOT coalesce(is_anonymous, false)
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account required' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guild_invite_private.valid_invite(p_token text)
 RETURNS guild_invite_private.link_invites
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE invite_row guild_invite_private.link_invites;
BEGIN
  IF p_token IS NULL OR p_token !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invite unavailable' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  SELECT i.* INTO invite_row FROM guild_invite_private.link_invites i
    JOIN public.guilds g ON g.id = i.guild_id
    JOIN public.guild_members gm ON gm.guild_id = g.id AND gm.traveler_id = i.leader_traveler_id
    WHERE i.token_hash = extensions.digest(p_token, 'sha256')
      AND i.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.expires_at > clock_timestamp()
      AND g.status = 'active' AND gm.role = 'leader' AND gm.status = 'active'
    FOR SHARE OF i, g, gm;
  -- A row lock can wait beyond expiry even when the WHERE matched before waiting.
  IF NOT FOUND OR invite_row.expires_at <= clock_timestamp() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invite unavailable' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  RETURN invite_row;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guild_lesson_activity_capture()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.guild_activity_log(guild_id, actor_traveler_id, event_type, entity_type, entity_id)
    VALUES (NEW.guild_id, NEW.created_by_traveler_id,
      CASE WHEN NEW.status = 'published' THEN 'lesson_published' ELSE 'lesson_created' END, 'lesson', NEW.id);
  ELSIF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
    INSERT INTO public.guild_activity_log(guild_id, actor_traveler_id, event_type, entity_type, entity_id)
    VALUES (NEW.guild_id, NEW.created_by_traveler_id,
      CASE WHEN NEW.status = 'published' THEN 'lesson_published'
           WHEN NEW.status = 'completed' THEN 'lesson_completed'
           WHEN NEW.status = 'cancelled' THEN 'lesson_cancelled' ELSE 'lesson_created' END,
      'lesson', NEW.id);
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guild_ops.actor(p_actor uuid, p_guild uuid, p_leader boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_role text;
BEGIN
 SELECT gm.role INTO v_role FROM public.guild_members gm JOIN public.travelers t ON t.id=gm.traveler_id
 JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=t.user_id JOIN public.guilds g ON g.id=gm.guild_id
 WHERE gm.traveler_id=p_actor AND gm.guild_id=p_guild AND gm.status='active' AND g.status='active'
   AND t.user_id=auth.uid() AND u.is_anonymous IS FALSE
   AND (gm.role<>'leader' OR g.leader_traveler_id=p_actor)
   AND (NOT p_leader OR (gm.role='leader' AND g.leader_traveler_id=p_actor)) FOR SHARE OF gm,g;
 IF v_role IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Guild access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN v_role;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guild_ops.visible(p_mission uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_missions m JOIN public.guild_members gm ON gm.guild_id=m.guild_id
 JOIN public.travelers t ON t.id=gm.traveler_id JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=t.user_id JOIN public.guilds g ON g.id=gm.guild_id
 WHERE m.id=p_mission AND gm.status='active' AND g.status='active' AND t.user_id=auth.uid() AND u.is_anonymous IS FALSE
 AND ((gm.role='leader' AND g.leader_traveler_id=gm.traveler_id) OR
   (m.status<>'draft' AND ((m.status='published' AND (m.audience='all' OR gm.traveler_id=ANY(m.target_traveler_ids))) OR
     EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_mission_progress p WHERE p.mission_id=m.id AND p.traveler_id=gm.traveler_id)))))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.leave_guild(p_traveler_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.owns_traveler(p_traveler_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Traveler not owned' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.guild_members SET status = 'left' WHERE traveler_id = p_traveler_id AND status = 'active' AND role <> 'leader';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Membership unavailable or leader must transfer leadership' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_guild_mission_progress(p_mission_id uuid, p_leader_traveler_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(traveler_id uuid, traveler_name text, progress_status text, completion_note text, submitted_at timestamp with time zone, completed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT t.id, t.name, coalesce(p.status, 'available'), p.completion_note, p.submitted_at, p.completed_at
  FROM public.guild_missions m JOIN public.guild_members gm ON gm.guild_id = m.guild_id AND gm.status = 'active'
  JOIN public.travelers t ON t.id = gm.traveler_id LEFT JOIN public.guild_mission_progress p ON p.mission_id = m.id AND p.traveler_id = gm.traveler_id
  WHERE m.id = p_mission_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_members own WHERE own.guild_id = m.guild_id AND own.traveler_id = p_leader_traveler_id AND own.role = 'leader' AND own.status = 'active') AND public.owns_traveler(p_leader_traveler_id) ORDER BY t.name
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.open_chest(p_traveler_id uuid, p_chest_type text, p_operation_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.publish_guild_mission(p_mission_id uuid, p_leader_traveler_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.owns_traveler(p_leader_traveler_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Leader not owned' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.guild_missions m SET status = 'published', published_at = coalesce(published_at, now())
  WHERE m.id = p_mission_id AND m.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_members gm WHERE gm.guild_id = m.guild_id AND gm.traveler_id = p_leader_traveler_id AND gm.role = 'leader' AND gm.status = 'active');
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mission unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
END $function$

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.owns_traveler(p_leader_traveler_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Leader not owned' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.guild_members target SET status = 'removed', updated_at = now()
  WHERE target.traveler_id = p_member_traveler_id AND target.role = 'member' AND target.status = 'active'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_members own WHERE own.guild_id = target.guild_id
      AND own.traveler_id = p_leader_traveler_id AND own.role = 'leader' AND own.status = 'active');
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Member unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_active_traveler(p_traveler_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.travelers
  SET is_active = false
  WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND is_active = true;

  UPDATE public.travelers
  SET is_active = true
  WHERE id = p_traveler_id AND user_id = auth.uid();

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Traveler not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_guild_lesson_status(p_lesson_id uuid, p_leader_traveler_id uuid, p_status text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.owns_traveler(p_leader_traveler_id) OR p_status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Action unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.guild_lessons lesson
    SET status = p_status, completed_at = CASE WHEN p_status = 'completed' THEN now() ELSE NULL END
    WHERE lesson.id = p_lesson_id AND lesson.status = 'published'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_members gm WHERE gm.guild_id = lesson.guild_id
        AND gm.traveler_id = p_leader_traveler_id AND gm.role = 'leader' AND gm.status = 'active');
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Lesson unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
END $function$

functions.signature: update_guild_mission_draft(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,text,text,text,text,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_guild_mission_draft(p_mission_id uuid, p_leader_traveler_id uuid, p_title text, p_description text, p_mission_type text, p_bible_reference text, p_bible_url text, p_completion_mode text, p_reward_tier text, p_starts_at timestamp with time zone, p_due_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.owns_traveler(p_leader_traveler_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Leader not owned' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.guild_missions m SET title = btrim(p_title), description = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_description,'')),''),
    mission_type = p_mission_type, bible_reference = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_bible_reference,'')),''),
    bible_url = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_bible_url,'')),''), completion_mode = p_completion_mode,
    requires_leader_approval = p_completion_mode = 'leader_approval', reward_tier = p_reward_tier,
    starts_at = p_starts_at, due_at = p_due_at, updated_at = now()
  WHERE m.id = p_mission_id AND m.status = 'draft'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_mission_progress p WHERE p.mission_id = m.id)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.guild_members gm WHERE gm.guild_id = m.guild_id
      AND gm.traveler_id = p_leader_traveler_id AND gm.role = 'leader' AND gm.status = 'active');
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Draft unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
END $function$
